name: Banjo-Kazooie Recompiled
description:
Banjo-Kazooie Recompiled is an enhanced native PC port of the classic Nintendo 64 platformer Banjo-Kazooie, created using static recompilation. It translates the original N64 binary into native C/C++ code, allowing the game to run with modern PC graphics and uncapped performance.

Features:
- Native execution without emulation overhead, providing smooth high framerates
- True widescreen, ultrawide, and arbitrary resolution rendering
- Modern camera controls with full analog stick and mouse support
- High-fidelity audio playback with support for enhanced sound output
- Native game controller support with remappable button layouts
